title: Be Careful What You Wish For
mainIdea: People should think carefully about what they wish for because actions can have unexpected consequences.

pages.text: Rylee received a strange necklace from her Uncle Aaron. A letter warned her to be careful with it.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: At school, Rylee wished her classmates liked the necklace. Suddenly, everyone thought it was amazing.

options: Her classmates to like the necklace
A brand new necklace from a shop in town
To go home early from school that day

pages.text: Later, Rylee wished for the highest score on her test. She got a perfect grade, but many classmates received low scores.

options: She lost her test paper somewhere inside the classroom
Her wishes seemed to cause unexpected problems
The necklace broke into pieces after her second wish

pages.text: Rylee became worried and visited a museum. She wanted to learn more about the necklace.

question.text: What did Rylee do to solve her problem?
options: She hid the necklace at the very back of her closet
She asked the museum for information about it
She gave it to a friend and asked her to keep it

pages.text: The museum explained that the necklace warned, "Be careful what you wish for." Rylee decided she did not want to keep it.

options: Rylee kept using the necklace for more and more wishes
Rylee decided she no longer wanted the necklace

elements.correct: Good luck and for her wishes to come true
distractors: New clothes and a phone for her birthday
A quiet week with no tests or homework

elements.correct: Her wishes seemed to have unexpected consequences
distractors: Her uncle asked her to return the necklace at once
Her necklace stopped working after the first wish

elements.correct: She visited a museum to learn about the necklace
distractors: She locked the necklace inside her school locker
She wrote a letter to Uncle Aaron for advice

elements.correct: She decided to get rid of the necklace
distractors: She hid the necklace and kept wishing
She made one last wish for her class
